Subject: Top-table intro + calendar fuse request: Pinecrest VP/CIO attendance

Hi Daniel,

Thanks again for taking time last week to review the short technical brief. We had a good read on Pinecrest’s sensitivity around latency and VPC isolation — I think there’s a strong fit on both product and procurement timelines.

Next step from our side: a 45-minute top-table demo that walks the CIO (if available) and the VP of Engineering through a concise run-of-show: runtime performance, routing/fallback policy, and our Dedicated private deployment options. Aim is to surface answers to the questions you raised about SLA guarantees and audit logging.

Can you confirm whether the CIO (Sophie Lin) is available the week of May 27? If not, is there a VP or an architect who should be present instead? We’ll hold a provisional calendar time until you confirm.

Draft agenda attached and a one-page playbook for the demo. Monica (CS lead) and Priyom (solutions) are cc’d to help with runbook and to join the session to handle deeper technical questions.

Proposed times (ET):
- Tue 28 May, 10:00–10:45
- Wed 29 May, 14:00–14:45
- Thu 30 May, 09:30–10:15 (shorter slot if leadership prefers)

If none of the above work, tell me two windows that do and we’ll adapt. Also a quick ask: are you comfortable with us recording the demo for internal alignment at Pinecrest? We won’t share externally.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Pinecrest_Redwood_TopTable_Agenda.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: MVP-demo-runbook.md (text)]

Aditya,

Appreciate the note and the materials. Sophie is in Brussels that week and won’t be available in the proposed windows. The VP of Eng, Marco Alvarez, can make time but he’s very tight. Emma (copied) manages Marco’s calendar — she can propose a slot.

That said, two asks:
1) Can you squeeze the session into 30 minutes? Marco prefers concise, focused demos with clear decision asks.
2) We need a short pre-brief doc for the CIO outlining the procurement/timeline impact in plain language (1 page). Sophie will read that instead of attending if she can’t join.

Thanks,
Daniel
